● Here are 40 tmux tips:

  1. Start a new session with tmux new-session -s name
  2. Attach to session with tmux attach-session -t name
  3. List all sessions with tmux list-sessions
  4. Detach from session with Ctrl-b d
  5. Kill a session with tmux kill-session -t name
  6. Create a new window with Ctrl-b c
  7. Switch windows with Ctrl-b n (next) or Ctrl-b p (previous)
  8. Jump to window N with Ctrl-b N (where N is 0-9)
  9. Split horizontally with Ctrl-b "
  10. Split vertically with Ctrl-b %
  11. Navigate panes with Ctrl-b arrow-keys
  12. Resize panes with Ctrl-b :resize-pane -D 5 (and U/L/R)
  13. Zoom a pane with Ctrl-b z
  14. Kill a pane with Ctrl-b x
  15. Rename window with Ctrl-b ,
  16. Rename session with tmux rename-session -t old new
  17. Choose and switch sessions with Ctrl-b s
  18. Choose and switch windows with Ctrl-b w
  19. Show time with Ctrl-b t
  20. Enter copy mode with Ctrl-b [
  21. Exit copy mode with q
  22. Search in copy mode with / then n for next
  23. Paste buffer with Ctrl-b ]
  24. List buffers with tmux list-buffers
  25. Save buffer to file with tmux save-buffer -b 0 filename
  26. Load config with tmux source-file ~/.tmux.conf
  27. Set prefix to Ctrl-a in config with set -g prefix C-a
  28. Enable mouse with set -g mouse on
  29. Increase history with set -g history-limit 10000
  30. Use vi keybindings with setw -g mode-keys vi
  31. Set status bar position with set -g status-position top
  32. Customize status bar with set -g status-left "#S"
  33. Show pane numbers with Ctrl-b q
  34. Select specific pane with Ctrl-b q then number
  35. Break pane into new window with Ctrl-b !
  36. Join pane from another window with tmux join-pane -t target
  37. Display pane info with Ctrl-b i
  38. Swap panes with Ctrl-b { or }
  39. Swap windows with tmux swap-window -t windows
  40. Run command without attaching with tmux new-session -d -s name command
